features: [ALL-IN-ONE VOLUME & GLOW BALM] Bring back the look of volume with this PDRN multi balm. Helps smooth the look of fine lines while delivering hydration and radiance — use on under eyes, cheeks, lips, neck, and even body areas for a plumper, more youthful-looking glow.
[VOLUFILINE BOOST] Powered by Volufiline, this balm helps improve the appearance of hollow areas like under eyes, cheeks, and smile lines for visibly fuller, plumper-looking skin.
[PDRN + COLLAGEN + NAD COMPLEX FOR THE BOUNCE] Formulated with PDRN, Collagen, NAD, Peptides, and Retinol to support elasticity, hydration, and a firmer, more youthful-looking complexion.
[GLOW & LINE CARE — DUAL FUNCTION] With caffeine and vitamin E, it helps improve the look of dark circles, puffiness, uneven tone, and fine lines for smoother, more radiant-looking skin.
[MELTING TEXTURE & ON-THE-GO CONVENIENCE] Smooth, non-sticky melting balm that glides effortlessly onto skin. Hygienic, mess-free stick format makes it perfect for quick touch-ups anytime, anywhere.
[GENTLE & SKIN-FRIENDLY FORMULA] Low-irritation tested and suitable for delicate areas like under eyes and lips. Free from artificial colorants and fragrance.
